'''Operation Dawnfire''' was a Solaran counteroffensive during the siege of [[Reasalbor]] in the [[Solara-Khalindar War]]. It targeted Khalindarian supply lines, forward bases, and military infrastructure after the fall of [[Congrave]].

== Background ==

Khalindar's advance toward Reasalbor depended on forward depots, captured routes, artillery sites, fuel stores, and improvised logistics networks. Solara's defenders could not rely on a simple frontal victory, so they focused on weakening the system that kept the siege moving.

== Operation ==

The operation combined strikes, raids, interdiction, and attacks on key logistical nodes. Solaran forces targeted transport corridors, ammunition dumps, command posts, and staging areas used by Khalindarian units around Reasalbor.

The exact units, commanders, and sequence of strikes need fuller tactical canon before publication as a detailed military article.

== Result ==

Dawnfire weakened Khalindar's ability to sustain the siege. It did not end the war, but it forced withdrawals, slowed the offensive, and helped Solara stabilize the front before the later [[Battle of Solara]] and the recapture of [[Congrave]].
